inputs.checklistItemText: Trees proposed within 10 lateral feet of pad-mounted electric equipment, or between equipment access door and drivable surface
inputs.question: On the electrical design plan (Sheet 21), are pad-mounted transformers or other pad-mounted electric equipment shown? If yes, identify their locations relative to trees shown on the landscape plan and indicate any pad-mounted equipment access doors.
